newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks at third record in week on jobs data.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks at third record in week on jobs data.

text.p: Mexican stocks continued their heady journey into uncharted territory on Friday by chalking up their third record close of the week.
Traders said confirmation of optimistic forecasts for unemployment data buttressed midday gains.
"The market was firm, buyers stepped in after the unemployment data were released," a desk trader.
Final closing figures situated the blue chip IPC index .MXX at a record 3,880.04 points, a gain of 40.31 points, or 1.05 percent.
